en.sayed-ali-raza: [The knowledge of the successor (wasi), his challenge “Ask me before you miss me” and prophecy about the Umayyads :] O people!
ask me before you miss me,
because certainly I am acquainted with the passages of the sky more than the passages of the earth,
[2] and before that mischief springs upon its feet which would trample even the nosestring and destroy the wits of the people.
